title: Best Ps5 Pro (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on mentions in TechRadar, PCWorld, IGN and CNET articles about the PS5 Pro.
assumptions: No price comparisons were made beyond the $700 figure cited; no other accessories were included because they were not referenced in the sources.

verdict.line: Buy it if you want the highest graphics performance and smoother frame rates on PlayStation, as the sources note its upgraded hardware and enhanced ray‑tracing. The main catch is its high price and lack of a disc drive.
